semiconductor_relevance: High — Stella International Corporation Limited provides advanced laser direct writing lithography systems and etching solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Stella International Corporation Limited is a key supplier of high-precision maskless laser direct writing equipment and ion etching systems in Taiwan and Greater China. The company focuses on enhancing production efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing through its advanced lithography systems and etching compensation software.
capabilities: High-precision maskless laser direct writing equipment

regional_presence.Taiwan: Stella International serves as the general agent for Heidelberg Instruments, focusing on the semiconductor market in Taiwan.
regional_presence.China: The company operates in Greater China, providing advanced lithography and etching solutions.
